rattle_1.name: Baby Rattle
rattle_1.desc: A rattle that deals {atk} damage per swing.

wooden_sword.name: Wooden Sword
wooden_sword.desc: A sturdy practice sword. Deals 8 damage per swing. It shines when you need to be brave.

popup_lines: {item} shines, and for a moment {name} is nobody's baby at all.
A clean bright courage runs out of {item} and into {name}'s chest.

pacifier.name: Blessed Pacifier
pacifier.desc: A soothing pacifier. Restores +1 HP at the start of each turn while equipped.

bottle.name: Milk Bottle
bottle.desc: A warm bottle of milk. Restores 15 HP.

onesie.name: Snuggle Onesie
onesie.desc: Soft padding adds +2 DEF. It holds warmth the way a hug does.

skirtP1.name: Pleated Schoolgirl Skirt
skirtP1.desc: A pleated skirt. May or may not cover your panties

diaper.name: Fluffy Diaper
diaper.desc: Extra padding. Protects against accidents. Hard to move in. ATK -1, DEX -2.

bunny_onesie.name: Bunny Onesie
bunny_onesie.desc: A fuzzy onesie with floppy bunny ears. Makes you want to hop and giggle! Something protective is woven into the thread.

rainbow_booties.name: Rainbow Booties
rainbow_booties.desc: Soft booties in every color! You can't help but wiggle your toes.

pacifier_necklace.name: Pacifier Necklace
pacifier_necklace.desc: A necklace with a big, silly pacifier. Makes you sound extra babyish!

giggle_mittens.name: Giggle Mittens
giggle_mittens.desc: Fluffy mittens that make you giggle when you swing them! It giggles. You wish it would not.

popup_lines: {item} lets out a high, delighted giggle and will not stop for a good while.
{item} laughs at {name} - properly laughs - and everyone nearby hears it.

cursed_lollipop.name: Cursed Lollipop
cursed_lollipop.desc: A magical lollipop that makes you feel extra silly and babyish! Increases shame.

tickle_feather.name: Tickle Feather
tickle_feather.desc: A silly feather that makes you giggle uncontrollably! Using it increases shame.

cotton_panties.name: Cotton Panties
cotton_panties.desc: Plain cotton underwear. Comfortable and practical.

lace_panties.name: Lace Panties
lace_panties.desc: Delicate lace underwear. Very pretty, very grown-up.

frilly_panties.name: Frilly Panties
frilly_panties.desc: Adorably frilly with little bows on the waistband. At least they're comfy.

training_pants.name: Training Pants
training_pants.desc: Thick padded cotton pants for... practice. Slightly restricts movement. DEX -1.

pull_up.name: Pull-Up
pull_up.desc: A padded pull-up in a cheerful cartoon print. Makes a crinkling sound when you walk. DEX -1.

printed_diaper.name: Printed Diaper
printed_diaper.desc: A thick diaper printed with colorful stars. Very obvious. Very babyish. ATK -1, DEX -2.

nighttime_diaper.name: Nighttime Diaper
nighttime_diaper.desc: An extra-thick overnight diaper. Enormous. Waddle-inducing. ATK -1, DEF -1, DEX -2.

plastic_panties.name: Crinkly Diaper Cover
plastic_panties.desc: Crinkly plastic cover worn over a diaper. Everyone within earshot will know it's there. DEX -1.

iron_dagger.name: Iron Dagger
iron_dagger.desc: A short, sharp blade. Quick and deadly. Deals 10 damage.

short_sword.name: Short Sword
short_sword.desc: A reliable one-handed sword. Deals 12 damage.

rolling_pin.name: Rolling Pin
rolling_pin.desc: Borrowed from a kitchen. Heavier than it looks. Deals 7 damage.

toy_wand.name: Toy Magic Wand
toy_wand.desc: A glittery plastic wand with a star on top. Surprisingly effective. Deals 5 damage.

plush_hammer.name: Plush Hammer
plush_hammer.desc: A giant stuffed mallet. Squeaks on impact. Deals 4 damage.

hair_bow.name: Big Hair Bow
hair_bow.desc: An enormous ribbon bow. Impossible to ignore.

princess_tiara.name: Princess Tiara
princess_tiara.desc: A sparkly tiara fit for a little princess. +1 CHA, probably. A faint warding warmth sits in the stitching.

witch_hat.name: Witch Hat
witch_hat.desc: A tall pointed hat. Marginally imposing. +1 DEF. Faint babbling leaks from it when nobody is listening.

popup_lines: Something inside {item} whispers nonsense words, and {name} catches herself repeating them.
{item} hums a nursery rhyme that {name} cannot stop mouthing along to.

knight_helm.name: Knight's Helmet
knight_helm.desc: A solid iron helmet. Heavy but protective. +3 DEF.

frilly_dress.name: Frilly Baby Dress
frilly_dress.desc: A poofy dress with layers of lace and ruffles. Adorable and a little embarrassing. +1 DEF.

leather_vest.name: Leather Vest
leather_vest.desc: Tough stitched leather. No nonsense protection. +3 DEF.

school_uniform_top.name: School Uniform Blouse
school_uniform_top.desc: A crisp white blouse with a Peter Pan collar. Very proper. +1 DEF.

knit_sweater.name: Knit Sweater
knit_sweater.desc: A soft woolly sweater with a duck pattern on the front. Cozy. +1 DEF.

bloomers.name: Puffy Bloomers
bloomers.desc: Billowy shorts gathered at the knee. Cute, but bulk over 2 will peek out.

overalls.name: Geometry Top
overalls.desc: Denim shortalls with big bib pockets. Hides most things. +1 DEF. Bulk 2+ may show.

blue_jeans.name: Blue Jeans
blue_jeans.desc: Classic denim. Good coverage, grown-up look. +1 DEF. Bulk 1+ may show.

short_shorts.name: Short Shorts
short_shorts.desc: Barely there. Everything is visible. Does not conceal panties.

knee_socks.name: Striped Knee Socks
knee_socks.desc: Tall socks with cheerful stripes. Very schoolgirl. The laces reach for each other when you walk.

magical_effects.lock_text: {item} lashes itself together and pitches {name} to a dead stop.

ruffle_socks.name: Ruffle Ankle Socks
ruffle_socks.desc: Tiny frilly socks with a lace trim. Unmistakably babyish.

ankle_socks.name: Ankle Socks
ankle_socks.desc: Plain white socks. Nothing to see here.

mary_janes.name: Mary Jane Shoes
mary_janes.desc: Shiny patent leather with a single strap buckle. Very dainty.

boots.name: Sturdy Boots
boots.desc: Heavy-duty boots that mean business. +2 DEF.

mossy_amulet.name: Mossy Amulet
mossy_amulet.desc: A crumbling stone pendant covered in luminous moss. Hums with old magic. +2 DEF.

willow_switch.name: Willow Switch
willow_switch.desc: A thin, whippy branch torn from a weeping willow. Stings terribly. Deals 14 damage. Your hand does not always agree to let go of it.

magical_effects.lock_text: {item} welds itself to {name}'s fist and locks her arm rigid.

toadstool_cap.name: Toadstool Cap
toadstool_cap.desc: A large red-and-white mushroom cap worn as a hat. Slightly poisonous aura. +2 DEF.

enchanted_blankie.name: Enchanted Blankie
enchanted_blankie.desc: A tattered security blanket that glows faintly in darkness. Warm and comforting. +3 DEF, but very babyish.

spider_silk_panties.name: Spider Silk Panties
spider_silk_panties.desc: Woven from enchanted spider silk. Nearly invisible but surprisingly sturdy. +1 DEF. The leg elastic grips like it has fingers.

magical_effects.lock_text: {item} clamps around {name}'s hips and thighs and simply will not let her walk.

fairy_dust_bottle.name: Fairy Dust Bottle
fairy_dust_bottle.desc: A tiny bottle of glittering fairy dust. Restores 25 HP and fully replenishes MP. Tastes like regret and sparkles.

cursed_paci_forest.name: Haunted Pacifier
cursed_paci_forest.desc: A ghostly pacifier that materialised from the forest fog. Restores +3 HP per turn but increases wet by 2 per step. Cannot be removed normally.

bramble_bow.name: Bramble Bow
bramble_bow.desc: A hair bow woven from thorny vines and tiny forest flowers. Pretty but prickly. +1 DEF.

cobweb_diaper.name: Cobweb Diaper
cobweb_diaper.desc: A thick diaper woven from enchanted cobwebs. Soft as clouds, embarrassing as everything. ATK -1, DEX -2. The leg elastic grips like it has fingers.

magical_effects.lock_text: {item} clamps around {name}'s hips and thighs and simply will not let her walk.

moonlit_rattle.name: Moonlit Rattle
moonlit_rattle.desc: A silver rattle that glows under moonlight. Its chime stuns forest creatures. Deals 11 damage.

wet_moss_boots.name: Wet Moss Boots
wet_moss_boots.desc: Boots grown from living moss. Always slightly damp. +2 DEF but -1 Wet Resist. They dance a little when nobody is watching.

popup_lines: {item} taps out three cheerful beats and {name} cannot help grinning.
Something bright and silly runs up through {item} and {name}'s whole day improves.

owl_feather_cap.name: Owl Feather Cap
owl_feather_cap.desc: A cap decorated with enchanted owl feathers. You feel wiser and slightly judgmental. +2 DEF. A faint warding warmth sits in the stitching.

ghostly_onesie.name: Ghostly Onesie
ghostly_onesie.desc: A translucent onesie that phases in and out of visibility. Spooky AND embarrassing. +3 DEF. The lining is always faintly, unpleasantly damp.

thorn_vine_skirt.name: Thorn Vine Skirt
thorn_vine_skirt.desc: A skirt woven from living thorny vines. It conceals what's underneath but pricks anyone who gets too close. +1 DEF.

mushroom_plug.name: Enchanted Mushroom Plug
mushroom_plug.desc: A smooth, magically-grown mushroom cork. Firm but gentle. +8 Tum Resist, -2 Wet Resist.

baby_wipes.name: Baby Wipes
baby_wipes.desc: A soothing pack of baby wipes. Cleans you up and settles the lingering shame - but your body grows a little more dependent on them.

baby_food.name: Baby Food
baby_food.desc: Mushy, sweet purée in a little jar. Restores some health, but sits extremely heavy in your tummy for a long time.

adult_food.name: Adult Food
adult_food.desc: A proper grown-up meal. Restores more health than baby food, and the tummy effects are milder and shorter-lived.

sippy_juice.name: Sippy Cup of Juice
sippy_juice.desc: A bright, overfull sippy cup of fruit juice. Restores some health, but it goes right through you.

water_bottle.name: Water Bottle
water_bottle.desc: A plain plastic water bottle. Restores some health. All that water has somewhere to go.

mystery_potion.name: Red Mystery Potion
mystery_potion.desc: A crimson bottle with a warm, metallic shimmer. It mends every bruise right away and leaves a fierce warmth in your chest.

mystery_potion_2.name: Pink Mystery Potion
mystery_potion_2.desc: A rosy little bottle that smells like candy and flowers. It patches you up halfway with a soft, sugary warmth.

mystery_potion_3.name: Black Mystery Potion
mystery_potion_3.desc: An inky bottle that swallows the light around it. The taste is dense and bitter, but somewhere underneath it your body feels a little steadier.

mystery_potion_4.name: Clear Mystery Potion
mystery_potion_4.desc: A nearly invisible draught that tastes like cold rain. Your body steadies and the last grime of embarrassment washes clean away.

mystery_potion_5.name: Blue Mystery Potion
mystery_potion_5.desc: A bright cerulean bottle that cools your throat on the way down. It heals you completely and leaves behind a deep, quiet chill.

mystery_potion_6.name: Green Mystery Potion
mystery_potion_6.desc: A fizzy green tonic that puts spring back in your legs. You feel lighter, quicker, and ready to keep moving.

mystery_potion_7.name: Purple Mystery Potion
mystery_potion_7.desc: A plum-colored cordial that hums with arcane static. Your magic surges back at once with a sharp little thrill.

mystery_potion_8.name: Orange Mystery Potion
mystery_potion_8.desc: A sunny orange bottle with a sharp citrus bite. It patches you up halfway and leaves a bright, restless energy behind.

mystery_potion_9.name: White Mystery Potion
mystery_potion_9.desc: A pearly white bottle that tastes strangely clean. It calms your nerves immediately and leaves you feeling fresh and composed.

mystery_potion_10.name: Teal Mystery Potion
mystery_potion_10.desc: A sea-glass bottle with a soothing mineral taste. It steadies your body right away with a cool, grounding calm.

mystery_potion_11.name: Gold Mystery Potion
mystery_potion_11.desc: A sparkling golden bottle that feels almost luxurious. It gives your body a quick lift and a pleasant little burst of vitality.

mystery_potion_12.name: Silver Mystery Potion
mystery_potion_12.desc: A silvery draught that crackles over your tongue like moonlight. It restores a little magic and clears your head in one bright flash.

mystery_potion_13.name: Indigo Mystery Potion
mystery_potion_13.desc: A dark blue bottle with a sleepy herbal scent. It goes down gently and leaves a dreamy herbal calm lingering in your body.

mystery_potion_14.name: Rose Mystery Potion
mystery_potion_14.desc: A soft rose bottle with a powdery floral taste. It seems quiet at first, but a soft clean feeling lingers underneath it.

stamina_potion.name: Stamina Potion
stamina_potion.desc: A fizzing sky-blue vial. Your legs feel solid the moment you pop the cork. Restores your stamina fully.

ghost_bloomers.name: Ghost Bloomers
ghost_bloomers.desc: Semi-transparent bloomers woven from ectoplasm. They shimmer and phase in and out of sight - unfortunately, so does whatever's underneath.

ghost_milk.name: Ghost Milk
ghost_milk.desc: A bottle of shimmering spectral milk. It's ice-cold and slightly see-through. Restores 20 HP.

ghostweave_dress.name: Ghostweave Dress
ghostweave_dress.desc: An ethereal baby dress stitched from ghost silk. The ruffles float as if underwater. Embarrassingly adorable. +3 DEF. It never seems to fit the same way twice.

popup_lines: {item} draws in a size, then another, until {name} can barely breathe in it.
The stitching of {item} creeps tighter, hugging {name} like it means to keep her.

ghostly_rattle.name: Ghostly Rattle
ghostly_rattle.desc: A phantom rattle that chills the air with every swing. Its eerie chime echoes through the forest. Deals 13 damage. Your hand does not always agree to let go of it.

magical_effects.lock_text: {item} welds itself to {name}'s fist and locks her arm rigid.

spectral_sword.name: Spectral Sword
spectral_sword.desc: A translucent blade of solidified moonlight. Rare and devastatingly sharp. Deals 18 damage. It gets heavier the longer you carry it.

thorn_crown.name: Thorn Crown
thorn_crown.desc: A circlet of living thorny brambles. It pricks your forehead but radiates protective magic. +2 DEF.

thorned_wand.name: Thorned Wand
thorned_wand.desc: A gnarled wand wrapped in thorny vines. Blooms with tiny flowers when it strikes. Deals 12 damage.

thorn_pacifier.name: Thorn Pacifier
thorn_pacifier.desc: A pacifier carved from enchanted thornwood. Surprisingly soothing - the thorns retract when sucked. +2 HP per turn, but -1 Wet Resist.

vine_plug.name: Vine Plug
vine_plug.desc: A smooth plug grown from enchanted vine roots. It curls snugly into place. +7 Tum Resist, -1 Wet Resist.

vine_skirt.name: Vine Skirt
vine_skirt.desc: A skirt woven from living green vines. Excellent coverage - the dense foliage hides almost anything. +1 DEF. The waistband gives up on you at random.

popup_lines: The waist of {item} loosens all at once and {name} grabs at it with both hands.
{item} slips down past {name}'s hips and settles there, entirely unhelpful.

root_boots.name: Root Boots
root_boots.desc: Boots grown from tangled tree roots. They grip the forest floor and feel alive. +2 DEF.

bark_armor.name: Bark Armor
bark_armor.desc: Plates of enchanted bark lashed together with living vines. Heavy but incredibly protective. +4 DEF.

mossy_socks.name: Mossy Socks
mossy_socks.desc: Socks woven from enchanted forest moss. Soft, springy, and faintly glowing. They squelch at the worst possible moments.

popup_lines: Every step in {item} makes a small wet noise that everyone nearby definitely heard.
{item} squelches once, loudly, into a perfectly quiet moment.

cobweb_panties.name: Cobweb Panties
cobweb_panties.desc: Gossamer-thin undies woven from enchanted spider silk. Nearly invisible but surprisingly sturdy. +1 DEF. A cold trickle of magic runs through the padding.

magical_effects.log_text: {item} leaks its hex through you: Wet +6, Shame -10.

cursed_swamp_diaper.name: Cursed Swamp Diaper
cursed_swamp_diaper.desc: A foul, mud-soaked diaper dredged from the swamp depths. Dark magic keeps it fastened. Constantly damp. ATK -2, DEX -3. Cannot be removed normally. A cold trickle of magic runs through the padding.

magical_effects.log_text: {item} leaks its hex through you: Wet +6, Shame -10.

enchanted_diaper.name: Enchanted Diaper
enchanted_diaper.desc: A softly glowing diaper infused with protective magic. Embarrassing, but it heals you over time. +1 HP per turn, +1 DEF. DEX -1.

mushroom_stew.name: Mushroom Stew
mushroom_stew.desc: A hearty stew brewed from enchanted forest fungi. Warm, filling, and restorative. Restores 20 HP.

foam_mallet.name: Foam Mallet
foam_mallet.desc: A gigantic padded foam mallet shaped like a toy. Deals {atk} damage and makes a very undignified BONK noise.

bottle_launcher.name: Bottle Launcher
bottle_launcher.desc: A pressurised milk-bottle that fires itself as a projectile. Deals {atk} damage and splashes warm milk everywhere on impact.

nursery_rattle.name: Jumbo Nursery Rattle
nursery_rattle.desc: A rattle the size of your head. Every swing makes a sound louder than a thunderclap. Deals {atk} damage.

knitting_needle_weapon.name: Repurposed Knitting Needle
knitting_needle_weapon.desc: A long steel needle recovered from a decommissioned NannyBot crafting unit. Surprisingly effective. Deals {atk} damage.

formula_wand.name: Formula Dispenser Wand
formula_wand.desc: A stolen wand attachment from a Formula Feeder Bot. Fires warming formula at enemies, confusing them. ATK 4. Hits in both DEF and WET categories. It giggles. You wish it would not.

popup_lines: {item} lets out a high, delighted giggle and will not stop for a good while.
{item} laughs at {name} - properly laughs - and everyone nearby hears it.

safety_helmet.name: Padded Safety Helmet
safety_helmet.desc: A thick foam helmet that the nursery requires all residents to wear. Embarrassing, but DEF +3.

sensor_cap.name: Bladder Sensor Cap
sensor_cap.desc: A monitoring cap that detects bladder pressure and broadcasts it over the local NannyBot network. DEF +0. Wet meter ticks 20% faster while worn. Deeply humiliating.

auto_tutu.name: Auto-Fitted Tutu
auto_tutu.desc: A bright pink tutu that snapped around your waist automatically when you walked past a robot. The layers of tulle make your diaper situation extremely obvious. DEF +1.

nursery_coverall.name: Nursery Coverall
nursery_coverall.desc: A snap-crotch coverall in pastel yellow. The snaps between the legs mean it has to come off completely for anything. DEF +2.

locking_bib.name: Locking Feeder Bib
locking_bib.desc: A heavy-duty bib with a magnetic clasp the NannyBots use for feeding. It clips around the neck and covers the front. Drool-resistant. DEF +1. The hem never stays where you put it.

popup_lines: The hem of {item} climbs by itself, and {name} spends the next minute tugging it back down.
{item} rides up at exactly the worst moment, as though it planned it.

potty_pants.name: Training Pants (Electronic)
potty_pants.desc: Soft training pants with embedded moisture sensors. Every time the sensors detect an accident, they play a cheerful little JINGLE at full volume. DEF +1.

lockable_bloomers.name: Locked Nursery Bloomers
lockable_bloomers.desc: Thick pastel bloomers with a small padlock at the waistband. Covers the diaper fully - not that it helps much with dignity. Cannot be removed. DEF +1.

auto_diaper.name: Auto-Taped Nursery Diaper
auto_diaper.desc: A thick mechanical diaper fired from a Diaper Dispenser Bot. The adhesive tabs deployed automatically and are bonded to your skin. Cannot be removed. ATK -2, DEX -3.

max_absorbency_diaper.name: Maximum Absorbency Diaper
max_absorbency_diaper.desc: An industrial nursery diaper rated for 24-hour continuous capacity. It is enormous. The packaging says 'For VERY small adventurers'. ATK -3, DEX -4.

nursery_nappy.name: Disposable Nursery Nappy
nursery_nappy.desc: A thin flat disposable nappy printed with little ducks wearing tiny hats. Minimal protection, maximum childishness. ATK -1, DEX -1.

activity_socks.name: Activity Socks (Jingles)
activity_socks.desc: White ankle socks with tiny jingle bells sewn around the cuff. Every step announces your presence. Adorable. Mortifying. DEF +1.

nursery_booties.name: Padded Nursery Booties
nursery_booties.desc: Thick foam booties that make no noise when you walk. The treads say 'BABY STEPS'. Snapped on by a NannyBot. DEF +2.

formula_bottle_an.name: Auto-Nursery Formula
formula_bottle_an.desc: Warm enriched baby formula in a big bottle with a soft nipple top. Restores 18 HP but the nutrients... do things. Wet meter +15 after digestion.

gummy_vitamins.name: Gummy Vitamins
gummy_vitamins.desc: Brightly coloured bear-shaped supplements from the nursery dispensary. Restores 8 HP. The fine print says 'may cause unpredictable gastric events'.

lullaby_syrup.name: Lullaby Syrup
lullaby_syrup.desc: A purple sleepy-time syrup the NannyBots dispense at bedtime. Restores 25 HP but causes an immediate bladder relaxation event. Wet meter +30.

nanny_juice_box.name: Nanny's Juice Box
nanny_juice_box.desc: A tiny juice box with a foil straw. Extremely sugary. Restores 12 HP and Tum +25 from all the sugar. You shouldn't have had three.

printed_diaper_auto.name: Printed Disposable (Rocket Ships)
printed_diaper_auto.desc: A cute printed disposable from the nursery supply closet. Covered in rocket ships and stars. 'TO INFINITY AND BEYOND!' on the waistband. ATK -1, DEX -2.

all_in_one_1.name: All In One #1
all_in_one_1.desc: A stylish all in one #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

all_in_one_2.name: All In One #2
all_in_one_2.desc: A stylish all in one #2. Fills both torso and pants slots.

baby_one_piece_1.desc: A stylish baby one piece #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

babydoll_top_1.desc: A stylish babydoll top #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

cat_bodysuit_1.desc: A stylish cat bodysuit #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

denim_shorttalls_1.desc: A stylish denim shorttalls #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

diaper_cover_all_1.desc: A stylish diaper cover all #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

frilly_dress_1.desc: A stylish frilly dress #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

magical_effects.popup_text: {item} suddenly cinches tight around your legs. You can't move!
magical_effects.log_text: {item} tightens and traps you in place.
magical_effects.lock_text: You wrestle with {item}, trying to free your legs...

hello_kitty_dress_1.name: Hello Kitty Dress #1
hello_kitty_dress_1.desc: A stylish hello kitty dress #1. Fills both torso and pants slots. Wearing it makes you stand a little taller.

popup_lines: {item} settles across {name}'s shoulders and she remembers, briefly, exactly who she is.
A quiet dignity moves through {item} and straightens {name}'s spine for her.

holey_all_in_one_1.name: Holey All In One #1
holey_all_in_one_1.desc: A stylish holey all in one #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

latex_apron_1.name: Latex Apron #1
latex_apron_1.desc: A stylish latex apron #1. Fills both torso and pants slots. The lining is always faintly, unpleasantly damp.

latex_playsuit_1.name: Latex Playsuit #1
latex_playsuit_1.desc: A stylish latex playsuit #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

loli_dress_1.name: Loli Dress #1
loli_dress_1.desc: A stylish loli dress #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

mummys_pumpkin_t_shirt_1.name: Mummys Pumpkin T Shirt #1
mummys_pumpkin_t_shirt_1.desc: A stylish mummys pumpkin t shirt #1. Fills both torso and pants slots. It wants to be worn a very particular way.

popup_lines: For one long second {name} feels stitched into {item} like a doll into its box.
{item} arranges {name}'s posture for her: shoulders back, hands folded, good girl.

net_body_suit_1.name: Net Body Suit #1
net_body_suit_1.desc: A stylish net body suit #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

pinafore_1.name: Pinafore #1
pinafore_1.desc: A stylish pinafore #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

pink_rubber_top_1.name: Pink Rubber Top #1
pink_rubber_top_1.desc: A stylish pink rubber top #1. Fills both torso and pants slots. It never seems to fit the same way twice.

The stitching of {item} creeps tighter, hugging {name} like it means to keep her.

pink_shorttalls_1.desc: A stylish pink shorttalls #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

pink_tutu_dress_1.desc: A stylish pink tutu dress #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

pumpkin_dress_1.desc: A stylish pumpkin dress #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

romantic_dress_1.name: Romantic Dress #1
romantic_dress_1.desc: A stylish romantic dress #1. Fills both torso and pants slots. Something protective is woven into the thread.

romper_2.desc: A stylish romper #2. Fills both torso and pants slots.

romper_3.desc: A stylish romper #3. Fills both torso and pants slots.

school_uniform_1.desc: A stylish school uniform #1. Fills both torso and pants slots.

school_uniform_2.desc: A stylish school uniform #2. Fills both torso and pants slots.

Moonlit magic from {item} makes {name}'s belly flutter.
magical_effects.lock_text: {item} catches and holds {name} in place for a moment.

mystical_amulet_1.name: Mystical Amulet
mystical_amulet_1.desc: An ancient amulet thrumming with unknown power. Wet resist +2, DEF +1. Its magic feels... maternal. Its maternal ward can wake at inconvenient times.

popup_lines: {item} glows with protective, embarrassingly gentle magic.
A soft ward from {item} steadies {name} like a hand at her back.
magical_effects.lock_text: {item} catches and holds {name} in place for a moment.

soulstone_1.name: Soulstone Pendant
soulstone_1.desc: A necklace holding a swirling violet soulstone. Whispers forgotten lullabies. HP regen +2, Childish +4. The soulstone sometimes gives back a little strength.

popup_lines: {item} drinks in the room's pressure and gives a little warmth back.
A violet glow in {item} steadies {name}'s pulse.
magical_effects.lock_text: {item} catches and holds {name} in place for a moment.

necktie_1.name: Striped Necktie
necktie_1.desc: A professional striped necktie. Makes you look serious and grown-up. Childish -2.

necktie_2.name: Polka Dot Necktie
necktie_2.desc: A colourful polka-dot necktie. Cheerful but slightly juvenile. At least you're dressed up.

scarf_1.name: Cozy Scarf
scarf_1.desc: A thick, warm scarf in autumnal colours. Comforting and practical. DEF +1. Cozy yarn magic can wrap you in warmth.

popup_lines: {item} snuggles closer, warm as a blanket.
Soft yarn magic from {item} helps {name} breathe easier.
magical_effects.lock_text: {item} catches and holds {name} in place for a moment.

scarf_2.name: Silk Scarf
scarf_2.desc: A lightweight silk scarf with an elegant drape. Sophisticated camouflage for your rather less sophisticated undergarments. It rings when you would most like to be invisible.

popup_lines: {item} rings out bright and clear, announcing {name} to absolutely everyone.
{item} chimes at exactly the volume needed for the whole room to turn around.

vampire_cape_1.name: Vampire Cape (Red)
vampire_cape_1.desc: A dramatic red-lined vampire cape. Sweeps behind you as you walk. Conceals panties! DEF +2. Crimson stage magic sometimes billows around you.

popup_lines: {item} billows dramatically, hiding {name} for one theatrical second.
A crimson flourish from {item} turns embarrassment into stagecraft.
magical_effects.lock_text: {item} catches and holds {name} in place for a moment.

vampire_cape_2.name: Vampire Cape (Purple)
vampire_cape_2.desc: A purple-lined vampire cape. Equally dramatic, slightly more regal. Conceals panties! DEF +2. Its purple glamour can briefly steady your nerves.

popup_lines: {item} casts a dusky glamour over {name}'s outline.
Purple shadow rolls from {item}, making {name} feel briefly untouchable.
magical_effects.lock_text: {item} catches and holds {name} in place for a moment.

accessories_apron.name: Frilly Apron
accessories_apron.desc: A cute frilly kitchen apron. Makes you look like a very little helper. Conceals panties from the front. DEF +1.

stethoscope_1.name: Stethoscope
stethoscope_1.desc: A proper medical stethoscope. Wearing this makes you look like a doctor, not a patient. Childish -3. DEF +1.

stethoscope_2.name: Toy Stethoscope
stethoscope_2.desc: A plastic toy stethoscope in bright pink. You're playing doctor! ...or are you the patient? The toy checkup charm beeps when it feels neglected.

popup_lines: {item} squeaks and announces: 'Checkup time for {name}!'
The toy diaphragm on {item} beeps out a nursery rhythm.
magical_effects.log_text: {item} performs a toy checkup: wet +4, HP +4.
magical_effects.lock_text: {item} catches and holds {name} in place for a moment.

combat_visor_1.name: Combat-Doll Visor
combat_visor_1.desc: A high-tech combat visor with a heads-up display. ATK +2, DEX +1. Finally, something that makes you look cool.

popup_lines: You feel something in the back of your mind dimming, as your subconscious mind interprets the instructions flawlessly.
Thousands of images flash in front of your eyes, too fast for your subconscious mind to interpret.

tartan_bra_earrings_1.name: Tartan Earrings
tartan_bra_earrings_1.desc: Dangly tartan-patterned earrings. Scottish chic meets dungeon fashion.

ball_gag_1.name: Ball Gag (Red)
ball_gag_1.desc: A classic red ball gag strapped tightly in place. Muffles speech completely. DEF +1. Shame -15.

ball_gag_2.name: Ball Gag (Pink)
ball_gag_2.desc: A pink ball gag with a heart-shaped buckle. Somehow cuter and more humiliating than the red one. It tastes faintly of warm milk.

magical_effects.log_text: {item} fills your belly with warm nothing: Tum +5, Wet +4.

ball_gag_3.name: Ball Gag (Black)
ball_gag_3.desc: A matte black ball gag. Industrial and severe. DEF +2. Shame -12.

bit_gag_1.name: Bit Gag
bit_gag_1.desc: A metal bit gag usually reserved for ponygirls. You can still drool freely. How dignified.

bone_gag_1.name: Bone Gag
bone_gag_1.desc: A gag shaped like a dog bone. For the pet who misbehaves. Woof.

dental_gag_1.name: Dental Gag
dental_gag_1.desc: A stainless steel dental retractor that forces your mouth open. Clinical, uncomfortable, deeply unsexy. DEF +1.

duck_gag_1.name: Duck Gag
duck_gag_1.desc: A gag shaped like a rubber duck bill. Quack quack. You look ridiculous. Childish +8.

facehugger_1.name: Facehugger Gag
facehugger_1.desc: A horrifying alien-inspired gag that wraps around your entire face. Nobody wants to look at you. DEF +2.

lips_gag_1.name: Lips Gag
lips_gag_1.desc: A gag with exaggerated inflatable lips on the outside. Makes you look like a cartoon character. Childish +5. It tastes faintly of warm milk.

magical_effects.log_text: {item} fills your belly with warm nothing: Tum +5, Wet +4.

portal_gag_1.name: Portal Gag
portal_gag_1.desc: A ring gag with a glowing portal inside it. Where does it lead? Best not to think about it. DEF +1. It finds its way back between your lips when you are not paying attention.

popup_lines: {name}'s jaw works at {item} before she notices she is doing it at all.
{item} presses forward on its own and {name} obediently latches on.

ring_gag_1.name: Ring Gag
ring_gag_1.desc: A simple metal ring gag. Keeps your mouth open. The drool is inevitable. It tastes faintly of warm milk.

magical_effects.log_text: {item} fills your belly with warm nothing: Tum +5, Wet +4.

pacifier_1.name: Pink Pacifier
pacifier_1.desc: A large adult-sized pacifier in bubblegum pink. Soothing but humiliating. HP regen +1. Childish +9.

pacifier_2.name: Blue Pacifier
pacifier_2.desc: An oversized baby-blue pacifier. The rhythmic sucking is... disturbingly calming. HP regen +1.

pacifier_3.name: Green Pacifier
pacifier_3.desc: A mint-green pacifier with a leaf motif. Forest-themed infantilization. HP regen +1.

pacifier_4.name: Purple Pacifier
pacifier_4.desc: A royal purple pacifier. Even the colour scheme can't make this dignified. HP regen +1.

pumpkin_paci_1.name: Pumpkin Pacifier
pumpkin_paci_1.desc: A pacifier shaped like a tiny pumpkin. Seasonal shame. HP regen +1. Childish +10.

spider_paci_1.name: Spider Pacifier
spider_paci_1.desc: A pacifier with a spiderweb pattern and tiny spider charm. Creepy AND infantilizing. HP regen +1. It finds its way back between your lips when you are not paying attention.

popup_lines: {name}'s jaw works at {item} before she notices she is doing it at all.
{item} presses forward on its own and {name} obediently latches on.

small_paci_gag_1.name: Pacifier Gag
small_paci_gag_1.desc: A pacifier with a strap that buckles behind the head. Can't spit it out. HP regen +2 but Cursed!

cock_paci_1.name: Adult Pacifier (Variant A)
cock_paci_1.desc: An adult-shaped pacifier. The shape is... suggestive. Deeply embarrassing. HP regen +1.

cock_paci_2.name: Adult Pacifier (Variant B)
cock_paci_2.desc: Another adult-shaped pacifier, this one even more explicit. The humiliation is the point. HP regen +1.

trail_rations.name: Trail Rations
trail_rations.desc: A sturdy packet of crackers, nuts, and dried fruit. Filling enough for a long dungeon walk.

dried_apple.name: Dried Apple Slices
dried_apple.desc: A paper pouch of tart apple slices. Light, portable, and easy on the tummy.

cheese_sandwich.name: Cheese Sandwich
cheese_sandwich.desc: A neatly wrapped sandwich with thick bread and melted cheese. A dependable proper meal.

berry_tart.name: Berry Tart
berry_tart.desc: A little pastry crowded with bright forest berries. Sweet, restorative, and surprisingly filling.

herbal_tea.name: Herbal Tea
herbal_tea.desc: A warm flask of mint and chamomile tea. Refreshing now, with the rest catching up a few turns later.

desert_electrolyte.name: Desert Electrolyte Flask
desert_electrolyte.desc: A chilled citrus drink mixed for Dustbreak heat. It restores a large amount of thirst and stamina.
